verses.text: For freedom did Christ set us free: stand fast therefore, and be not entangled again in a yoke of bondage.

segments.text: For freedom did Christ set us free: stand fast therefore, and be not entangled again in a yoke of bondage.

verses.text: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that, if ye receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

segments.text: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that, if ye receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

verses.text: Yea, I testify again to every man that receiveth circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

segments.text: Yea, I testify again to every man that receiveth circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

verses.text: Ye are severed from Christ, ye who would be justified by the law; ye are fallen away from grace.

segments.text: Ye are severed from Christ, ye who would be justified by the law; ye are fallen away from grace.

verses.text: For we through the Spirit by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

segments.text: For we through the Spirit by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

verses.text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision; but faith working through love.

segments.text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision; but faith working through love.

verses.text: Ye were running well; who hindered you that ye should not obey the truth?

segments.text: Ye were running well; who hindered you that ye should not obey the truth?

verses.text: This persuasion came not of him that calleth you.

segments.text: This persuasion
came
not of him that calleth you.

verses.text: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

segments.text: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

verses.text: I have confidence to you-ward in the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

segments.text: I have confidence to you-ward in the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

verses.text: But I, brethren, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? then hath the stumbling-block of the cross been done away.

segments.text: But I, brethren, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? then hath the stumbling-block of the cross been done away.

verses.text: I would that they that unsettle you would even go beyond circumcision.

segments.text: I would that they that unsettle you would even go beyond circumcision.

verses.text: For ye, brethren, were called for freedom; only use not your freedom for an occasion to the flesh, but through love be servants one to another.

segments.text: For ye, brethren, were called for freedom; only
use

verses.text: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, even in this: Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.

segments.text: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word,
even

verses.text: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

segments.text: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

verses.text: But I say, Walk by the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

segments.text: But I say, Walk by the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

verses.text: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; for these are contrary the one to the other; that ye may not do the things that ye would.

segments.text: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; for these are contrary the one to the other; that ye may not do the things that ye would.

verses.text: But if ye are led by the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

segments.text: But if ye are led by the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

verses.text: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these: fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

segments.text: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are
these

verses.text: idolatry, sorcery, enmities, strife, jealousies, wraths, factions, divisions, parties,

verses.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,

verses.text: And they that are of Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with the passions and the lusts thereof.

verses.text: If we live by the Spirit, by the Spirit let us also walk.

verses.text: Let us not become vainglorious, provoking one another, envying one another.
